description: Measure an owned armed GLB instance and return its editable weapon/motion profile: explicit family, holding hand, dimensions, grip anchors, handle and cutting-edge axes. Use gripforge_attach first. Default axes are +Y handle and +Z edge; inspect/correct them. Does not mutate the Library source or certify the initial seating.

family.description: Required on the first call. Never infer axe vs sword from geometry alone.

secondaryAnchor.description: Required for two hands; weapon-node local coordinates.
